subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text.
stimulus: Karim said to Pavel, "Good morning. Why did you miss the most important class on the rules of passage narration yesterday?" "Alas! What a fool I am! Please help me on the topic. I will never miss any important class." "Don't do this. Let us discuss the topic." Karim said.
guide_solution: Changing the form of speech Sabina wished Alam happy birthday and also said that he was looking very smart. Alam replied with thanks for her appreciation. Alam asked about Manika and wanted to know where she was and added that if she wouldn't come. Sabina replied feeling sorry that Manika had gone to hospital with her mother. Then Alam asked why Manika had gone there. Then Sabina replied that her (M) mother had fallen on the road and had lost her sense. Then Alam proposed to go to the hospital.

subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text.
stimulus: Sabina said to Alam, "Happy birthday to you. You are looking very smart." "Thanks for your appreciation," said Alam. "Where is Manika? Won’t she come?" "Sorry, she has gone to hospital with her mother." she replied. "But why," he asked. "She fell on the road and lost sense," said Sabina. "Let’s go to the hospital," said Alam.
